# Embodied MVP verdict: stimulus-sign reversal

Verdict: **FAIL** - at least one seed did not turn with the stimulus sign

Generated 2026-10-05T17:02:35.064951+00:00 by `python -m neurofly_body verdict` (neurofly_body 0.1.0, telemetry format 2, decoder `dn-v2`).

Every condition is the same real graph and the same articulated FlyGym body, differing only in the stimulus sign, the seed, or the declared control.

## Reversal

- seed 0: +w turns -0.006 rad, -w turns +0.011 rad - follows the stimulus sign: False; DNa02 L-R asymmetry reverses: True
- seed 1: +w turns +0.038 rad, -w turns -0.007 rad - follows the stimulus sign: False; DNa02 L-R asymmetry reverses: True

## Controls

- `seed0-drive-channel-swapped`: the recorded intact drive with its left and right channels exchanged. Every value and every total reaching the CPG is identical; only which side receives it is mirrored. If the body follows which side the command came from, the turn reverses.
- `seed0-drive-time-shuffled`: the recorded intact drive with its time order permuted (both channels moved together, so each channel's values and mean are exactly preserved and the left/right pairing is intact), using one fixed permutation (seed 20260926). It tests only whether same-sign turning survives that one permutation; it cannot show that the time course is irrelevant or that the turn is carried by the mean alone.
- measured, `seed0-output-disconnected`: cumulative yaw +0.007 rad - the turn is absent when the output path is cut
- measured, `seed0-drive-channel-swapped`: cumulative yaw -0.006 rad (source run -0.006 rad) - uninformative: the intact run it was built from did not turn beyond 0.2 rad, so there was no turn to reverse or keep
- measured, `seed0-drive-time-shuffled`: cumulative yaw -0.009 rad (source run -0.006 rad) - uninformative: the intact run it was built from did not turn beyond 0.2 rad, so there was no turn to reverse or keep

## What this does and does not establish

- The input is imposed, not seen: the stimulus sign is injected directly into the T4/T5 direction-selective neurons by the optomotor encoder, so no photoreceptor motion computation is tested. Any result here is about the circuit downstream of T4/T5 and the body only.
- The reversal did not pass (FAIL: at least one seed did not turn with the stimulus sign), so this run does not establish stimulus-sign-appropriate turning through the dn-v2 decoder: DNp09 sets the forward drive of the contralateral legs, DNa02 shortens ipsilateral strides, MDN reverses, GF logs a takeoff event.
- What it does not establish: behavioural competence. In the reversal conditions the fly travels 0.1-0.6 mm in 5 s, against 10-20 mm/s for a real walking fly.
- The sample is a handful of descending neurons: the DNp09 counts set the forward drive and the DNa02 counts set the turn, so the whole motor command derives from the spike counts in this table.
- Across the 4 reversal conditions DNp09 fired 0 times and MDN 81 times; the DNa02 L-R asymmetry reversed with the stimulus on 2 of 2 seeds. Under dn-v2 DNa02 only shortens the strides of an existing forward drive, so a DNa02 asymmetry turns the fly only when DNp09 supplies that drive.
- Baseline at zero stimulus (`seed0-zero-w`): the fly travels 0.12 mm and turns +0.009 rad, from spontaneous graph activity (DNa02_L 15, DNa02_R 9, GF_R 17, MDN_L 7, MDN_R 3); the decoder has no tonic term.
- The DN-to-CPG decoder is an engineered bridge, not a ventral nerve cord, and FlyGym's own leg-retraction, stumbling and adhesion machinery is active in every condition, including the disconnected control.
- No closed-loop DN modulation is demonstrated: body feedback is wired, but its effect on the DN readout is not resolvable at these spike counts.

## Reuse check

- re-ran all 2500 records (5 s, the whole condition) of `seed0-positive-w` from the reused graph and body after every other condition and got byte-identical telemetry to the fresh run: over this full-duration comparison no state survived the resets, so the conditions are comparable

## Identity

- graph `eab575f63211`, 166,700 neurons
- brain backend `cpu`, LIF dynamics `v3`, transmitter policy `v3-modulatory-only`, engineered assistance `False`
- optomotor IO map `228c1b69251e`, locomotion DN map `45747a07e026`
- each condition sets the server's optomotor_seed to its own seed before the reset, so a condition is equivalent to a standalone `run --seed <seed>` on a freshly loaded server
- wall time 21.5 min for 8 conditions plus the reuse check

## Reproduce

The brain backend is pinned to `cpu`, the backend that produced these numbers: CPU and CUDA agree statistically, not bit for bit, so an unpinned (`auto`) backend may not reproduce them. Every parameter is given explicitly, defaults included, and floats are written exactly. Replace `<fresh-dir>` with a new directory. `<repo>` is the root of the checkout the command runs from (the CLI maps it); a data directory outside the repository is read from `NEUROFLY_GRAPH_DIR` / `NEUROFLY_CONNECTOME_DIR`. The files are verified against the sha256 values below when they load. The command refuses to run if a model override (`NEUROFLY_LIF_E_INH_MV`, `NEUROFLY_LIF_DYNAMICS`, `NEUROFLY_GRADED_POLICY`, `NEUROFLY_CUDA_IMPL`) is set.

```bash
NEUROFLY_BRAIN_BACKEND=cpu python -m neurofly_body verdict --output '<fresh-dir>' --duration 5.0 --seeds 0 1 --angular-velocity 4.0 --contrast 1.0 --neural-dt-ms 2.0 --physics-dt-s 0.0001 --warmup-s 0.05 --decoder dn-v2 --decoder-tau-ms 50.0 --max-cpg-drive 1.2 --p9-gain-per-hz 0.02 --dna02-stride-k-per-hz 0.01 --mdn-gain-per-hz 0.02 --cpg-gain-per-hz 0.04 --full-controls --reuse-check-duration 5.0 --graph-dir '<repo>/outputs/brainlab/malecns_v1' --connectome-dir '<repo>/connectome_data/malecns_v1'
```

## Known measurement traps

- `thorax.yaw_rad` is an `atan2` angle in (-pi, pi], so it cannot be used as a signed turn: a real +3.168 rad turn once read -3.116 rad there. The verdict judges an unwrapped cumulative yaw and reports both.
- A reused `ConnectomeServer` rebuilds its optomotor encoder from `optomotor_seed` on `reset()`, so that attribute is set per condition (and for the reuse check); otherwise every condition runs on one seed's noise stream.
